root_cause: The scheduled social delivery function queried Buffer before invoking the canonical publisher, so a Buffer outage or 429 could prevent an otherwise healthy Instagram/Composio publication attempt.
prevention: Invoke the canonical publisher before any Buffer read so provider-isolated lanes can progress independently.
Treat Buffer read failures as LinkedIn provider deferrals rather than a global social-delivery failure.
Never let a provider-specific outage suppress publication attempts on another provider lane.
